description: Run a Python script in a uv or pixi project's environment (synced first with sync_environment). The project directory holds pyproject.toml (+ uv.lock) or pixi.toml (+ pixi.lock); the job runs there.

project.description: the project directory, synced with sync_environment

script.description: the .py file to run (usually inside the project)

args.description: arguments for the script, separated by single spaces (no quotes or shell characters)
